offering_description.value: Edwards Lifesciences develops and manufactures implantable heart valve devices for hospitals and cardiac care teams. Its devices are used in catheter-based and open-heart procedures, and it also makes implantable pressure sensors for monitoring heart failure.

primary_products.value: Transcatheter aortic valves; surgical tissue heart valves; surgical valve repair rings; transcatheter mitral and tricuspid repair and replacement devices; implantable pulmonary artery pressure sensors

customer_segment.value: B2B: Private hospitals, health systems and specialty cardiac centers; B2G: Government-operated hospitals and public health systems

end_markets.value: Interventional cardiology; cardiac surgery; heart failure care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Implantable valves, valve repair devices and heart failure monitoring devices

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses tissue and engineered components to manufacture cardiac implants and delivery systems for hospitals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Transcatheter aortic valves, surgical valve therapies, transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies, and heart failure monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving hospitals and cardiac programs; distributors / dealers: Independent medical device distributors in some international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Implantable cardiac devices subject to FDA premarket approval and EU Medical Device Regulation conformity assessment

notes: The current commercial footprint of its heart failure monitoring line is uncertain.
